decisions: Vault restore becomes transactional and exact for the filtered managed scope.
Machine-local backup configuration and runtime paths are never restored.
A post-restore interlock blocks scheduled pushes until explicit acceptance.
Git-branch SpecStore is the recommended live cross-machine authority; Vault remains disaster recovery.
constraints: Existing vaults without manifests must remain readable.
Do not include docs/specs or repository code in Vault backup.
Do not restore sessions, locks, caches, or server runtime state.
Preserve current backup and vault CLI aliases.
nonGoals: Merge divergent workflow histories in the backup engine.
Automatically migrate repositories to git-branch storage.
implementationNotes: The incident showed copyDirRecursive overlay at pull left stale workflow directories.
Dashboard startup immediately invokes runScheduledPushIfDue, so restorePending must be checked below that entry point.
Push currently fetches and checks out remote main before rewriting it, which masks a remote authority change unless compared with machine-local lastSha.
